assertions: One normalized USER.md or direct knowledge/*.md change is bound to its base, current and desired content digests.
A production Personal Knowledge Base runs proposal, explicit confirmation, atomic write, Git commit and receipt in an isolated temporary repository.
Target drift is blocked and an already-satisfied desired state is recognized without creating a second review revision.
Exact content, path, provenance or base changes invalidate the review revision hash.
The public result never creates a proposal, writes durable memory, commits Git, issues a receipt or authorizes execution.
